summary_en: Correction notice to July 10, 2026 disclosure on capital-cost and share-price conscious management. Error in page 7, section 4 (profitability improvement initiatives). Specific amended figures not shown in excerpt.
title_en: Correction: Partial Correction Notice to 'Response Toward Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price (Update)'
translation_en_brief: Hi-Lex Corporation issued a correction notice on July 10, 2026, to its prior-day disclosure on capital-cost and share-price conscious management (update). The company identified an error in page 7, section 4 ('Initiatives for Enhanced Profitability'), and has corrected the content as shown in the red-boxed revision table (the specific figures are not reproduced in the provided excerpt). No other material terms or new commitments are introduced in this correction filing.
